items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: studying with him through Mesmesro, who I'd known. I met him when he was playing at Ryan's.

ctx.x: When did you first hear him in person? Can you remember that?

Yeah, the first time I heard him in person was at a swing soiree that was called, it was held at a place called the Pied Piper in Greenwich Village. I remember that. Which, uh, in recent years was called the Cafe Bohemia. They used to have a lot of modern jazz groups there. It was on Barrow Street. And, uh, Wilbur de Paris ran some sessions there. And this particular one he had Sidney and, uh, Bill Coleman on trumpet and Mary Lou Williams. It was, that was the first time I heard Sidney in person. It was…
Well, I never really knew anything about that school. Oh yeah. Did he really, was it gonna be a real school?
